page_title: WOL 2-1 LUT | Wolves v Luton 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' David Coote is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Luke Berry (Luton) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+5' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90+5' The percentage of ball possession is – 57:43.
90+3' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fred Onyedinma (Luton) will replace Alfie Doughty.
85' Gary O'Neil is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Rayan Ait-Nouri suffers an injury and Hugo Bueno (Wolves) comes on.
85' The game is interrupted now, Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' Wasted opportunity. Cauley Woodrow (Luton) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
83' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

83' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Luton.
81' A yellow card for a tackle by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves). David Coote doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
80' 2 - 1 Reece Burke feeds the ball through to Carlton Morris (Luton), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the right side of the goal! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:1!
80' Alfie Doughty (Luton) prepares to take a corner kick.
79' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and David Coote blows for a foul.
78' Here is a change. Ross Barkley is going off and Rob Edwards gives the last tactical orders to Elijah Adebayo (Luton).
78' Matt Doherty (Wolves) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Matheus Cunha as he is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
76' Mario Lemina (Wolves) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
75' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
74' A cross into the box from Alfie Doughty (Luton) is cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Luton.
73' The total number of attempts is 12:5.
72' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
71' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
67' Joao Gomes (Wolves) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
67' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Wolves will have a corner.
66' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Daiki Hashioka and he is replaced by Cauley Woodrow (Luton).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Clark trots off the pitch and is replaced by Luke Berry (Luton).
63' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
62' Joao Gomes (Wolves) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
61' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Wolves have a corner.
58' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
58' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
56' Matt Doherty (Wolves) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
55' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) makes a strong challenge and David Coote blows for a foul.

50' 2 - 0 Mario Lemina sends a superb cross into the box. Toti (Wolves) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Thomas Kaminski beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:0.
50' The referee awards a corner and Joao Gomes (Wolves) goes over to take it.
50' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves). Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Poor challenge! Alfie Doughty (Luton) is penalised for tripping and David Coote blows his whistle.
48' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
46' The whistle blows and David Coote starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
44' Gabriel Osho (Luton) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
44' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

39' 1 - 0 Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Thomas Kaminski is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.

38' Joao Gomes (Wolves) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
37' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.

36' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
33' The foul by Alfie Doughty (Luton) was seen by David Coote who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
31' Tahith Chong (Luton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
29' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
26' Toti (Wolves) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Thomas Kaminski.
24' Jordan Clark (Luton) and Albert Sambi Lokonga attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
23' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
22' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

21' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Thomas Kaminski makes a great save to stop his effort. Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
20' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
16' Dangerous play by Matheus Cunha (Wolves). David Coote blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Carlton Morris (Luton) latched on to a cross into the box and headed the ball under the crossbar. A decent header but it lacked power, allowing the goalkeeper to make a comfortable save.
13' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
11' The foul by Joao Gomes (Wolves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by David Coote.
10' Thomas Kaminski displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
8' Carlton Morris (Luton) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
6' Tahith Chong (Luton) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
5' Jordan Clark (Luton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
3' Foul! Daiki Hashioka (Luton) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.

The players are out at last! Luton will take the kick-off.
